rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Northgate Servicing escrow accounts under RESPA section 10 and Regulation X (12 CFR 1024.17), with errors handled under 1024.35. Topics: analysis, cushion, surplus, disputes. Analysis A-2026-09 was issued on 18 September 2026 for the escrow year 1 November 2026 to 31 October 2027. Loan L-4486 is current.

Each year Northgate projects the coming year's disbursements from the bills it has, or the last bill paid when no new one is known. Northgate pays each escrowed bill on or before its due date; a penalty caused by a late payment from escrow is Northgate's cost and is never charged to the borrower's escrow.
The cushion Northgate may hold is no more than one-sixth of the estimated total annual disbursements from the account (two months), computed on the disbursements as they should be projected.

A surplus of $50 or more shown on an analysis is refunded to a current borrower within 30 days of the analysis date; a surplus under $50 may be refunded or credited against next year's payments. A borrower may ask for the refund of a surplus already shown while a dispute of other lines is open; a corrected analysis refunds any further surplus it finds.

Dispute a line through this portal: each dispute is a written notice of error under 12 CFR 1024.35, one per line, with the amount the line should be. Northgate acknowledges it in 5 business days and corrects it or explains within 30 business days, then issues a corrected analysis. Send the disputes and any surplus request the same day; do not hold one for another.
